name: Mayoeru Futari to Sekai no Subete
original_name: 迷える2人とセカイのすべて
source:
For the last ten-plus years, Kazuma has been seeing a repeated dream. In this dream, his younger self met a beautiful elf in the forest, who put the pendant that she was wearing in his hand and wished for him to save her daughter in the future. Even though it felt like just a dream, the pendant which he held was indeed real. However, he had never met the elf nor her daughter, and now continues to spend his days as a normal student in the boarding school Kuondai Gakuen.

One time, he noticed a blonde girl staggering about at the top of the stairs. She fainted, but he was able to catch her in the nick of time. It appeared that he was the only one who could see her. Then, he remembered one of the school’s seven mysteries: “There is an invisible girl wandering about the school.”

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在过去的十多年里，和真一直重复着一个梦。在这个梦中，年轻的自己在森林里遇见了一位美丽的精灵，精灵将自己佩戴的吊坠放在他的手中，祈求他将来能够拯救自己的女儿。虽然感觉就像是在做梦，但他手上拿着的吊坠却是真实存在的。然而，他从未见过精灵和她的女儿，现在继续在寄宿学校久远学园里以普通学生的身份度过日子。

有一次，他注意到一个金发女孩在楼梯顶上摇摇晃晃。她晕倒了，但他及时接住了她。看来，只有他一个人能看到她。然后，他想起了学校七大谜团之一：“有一个隐形女孩在学校里徘徊。”

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
